parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe a simple way that a student, without requiring any additional equipment, can detect when a stationary wave is formed in the air column as the tube is being raised.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Determine the height of the top end of the tube above the surface of the water when a stationary wave is first produced in the tube. Assume that an antinode is formed level with the top of the tube.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Determine the distance moved by the tube between the positions at which the first and second stationary waves are formed.
